chiSiamo.label: About Us
chiSiamo.title:
Not just wine.
But a culture of taste
chiSiamo.body1: In Gaiole in Chianti, at the heart of Chianti Classico, La Cantinetta del Chianti is a small wine shop and deli dedicated to selecting wines and gastronomic excellence from the territory.
chiSiamo.body2: A place born from a passion for quality, authenticity and a deep connection with Tuscany, with the aim of offering experiences that tell the story of the land through its wines and flavours.

hero.subtitle: A curated selection of labels from Chianti and Tuscany, chosen for quality, character and story.

testo.body1: Born from a passion for wine, La Cantinetta del Chianti is a place where every bottle tells a story. A mosaic of great labels carefully selected to offer our customers a choice spanning from excellence to the sublime. An ideal journey through Italy's wine regions: from Tuscany to Sicily, through the prestigious lands of Piedmont, Lombardy, Veneto and Friuli. Every glass is a sensory experience that elevates the pleasure of the nose and celebrates the apotheosis of taste.
testo.body2: Our gaze extends beyond Italian borders, with an international selection embracing the great winemaking and spirits traditions: from the refinement of France and Germany, to the character of Spain, to the excellence of Scotch and Irish whiskies and celebrated American bourbons. Not forgetting Argentina, land of intense and surprising wines.
testo.quote: Let yourself be guided on a journey of taste

galloNero.label: The territory
galloNero.title:
The legend
of the Black Rooster
galloNero.p1: The Black Rooster, historic symbol of Chianti Classico, has told the story of this land for centuries.
galloNero.p2: Legend has it that Florence and Siena decided to settle their borders through a challenge between knights, whose departure would be signalled by the first crow of a rooster. The Florentines chose a black rooster kept without food, which crowed before dawn, allowing their knight to set off early and advance as far as Fonterutoli, just a few kilometres from Siena.
galloNero.p3: Since then, the Black Rooster has become the symbol of Chianti and its historic tradition.

storia.label: Our story
storia.title:
The story of
La Cantinetta del Chianti
storia.p1: It was the spring of 2000 when I had the pleasure of discovering the wonderful territory of Chianti Classico for the first time.
storia.p2: Having left Basilicata for a job interview at an agriturismo, as I approached Tuscany I became increasingly aware of how unique that landscape was: gentle hills, extraordinary vineyards and a harmony that was hard to forget.
storia.p3: Arriving in Gaiole in Chianti, I had the clear feeling of having arrived somewhere special, almost a "paradise".
storia.p4: I worked for three years at an agriturismo as restaurant manager. Then, driven by a passion for wine and the pleasure of tasting Tuscan "nectar", I decided to change direction.
storia.p5: In 2003 I took over La Cantinetta del Chianti, beginning a journey of passion, research and love for this territory that I continue to pursue every day.

filosofia.title: Our philosophy
filosofia.p1: Our selection is the result of careful and continuous research, guided by the desire to promote local producers and those who share our values.
filosofia.p2: Every choice is designed to accompany the customer on a simple, authentic and tailored journey.
